about: NASA's nine Artemis III candidate landing regions (Oct 28, 2024), all within about 6 degrees of the south pole. NASA has not published region centres, so each search area is placed on the feature the region is named after (IAU / USGS Gazetteer coordinates) and made large enough to contain it. The app scores spots across each search area and ranks regions by their best spot. Replace lat/lon/size_km with NASA's exact regions if you get them.
source: search areas centred on the named features (USGS Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature), not NASA's exact region outlines
